description: This file implements a notifier for block change notifications in a collaborative workspace, managing notification hints, subscriber notifications, and diff generation.

classes.name: notifier
classes.description: Handles block change notifications, manages notification hints, and delivers updates to subscribers.

methods.name: newNotifier
methods.description: Creates a new notifier instance with provided backend parameters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the notification loop if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the notification loop if running.

methods.name: onNotifyHint
methods.description: Enqueues a notification hint for processing.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Fetches the next notification hint and triggers subscriber notifications.

methods.name: notifySubscribers
methods.description: Generates diffs and sends notifications to subscribers for a given hint.
